document.title: Weekend cross-dock staffing (Acme)
document.text: On weekends the Acme cross-dock runs a reduced staffing roster: one duty supervisor covers both docks, and any load arriving after 18:00 on Saturday waits for the Sunday morning crew unless the duty supervisor releases it.

document.text: When a Globex trailer seal is cut for inspection, the security desk issues a replacement seal from the numbered cabinet and records both seal numbers in the handover log before the trailer moves.
